record.original_question: Determine the geometrical (rectilinear) crossing number of the complete graph K_n, where every edge must be drawn as a straight-line segment.

evidence.quote: Problem 2.4 Find the geometrical crossing number of the complete graph.

artifact.self_contained_problem: For an integer $n \ge 1$, a rectilinear drawing of the complete graph $K_n$ in the Euclidean plane is an assignment of the $n$ vertices to $n$ points in general position (no three collinear) together with the drawing of each of the $\binom{n}{2}$ edges as the straight-line segment joining the two corresponding points. The number of crossings of such a drawing is the number of unordered pairs of edges whose relative interiors intersect. The rectilinear (geometric) crossing number $\overline{\mathrm{cr}}(K_n)$ is the minimum number of crossings over all rectilinear drawings of $K_n$.\n\nDetermine $\overline{\mathrm{cr}}(K_n)$ as an explicit function of $n$ (equivalently, give a closed-form formula, or determine the exact value of the limit $\lim_{n\to\infty} \overline{\mathrm{cr}}(K_n)\big/\binom{n}{4}$ together with matching constructions and lower bounds).
artifact.status_search_result: The rectilinear crossing number of $K_n$ is a long-standing open problem. Exact values are known only for small $n$ (up to roughly $n=27$ via computer-aided enumeration by Aichholzer and collaborators), and the asymptotic constant $q^* = \lim \overline{\mathrm{cr}}(K_n)/\binom{n}{4}$ is bounded between roughly $0.379972$ and $0.380488$ but its exact value remains unknown.

status_evidence.title: Rectilinear crossing number - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The rectilinear crossing numbers for K_n are known for n up to 27... The exact value is unknown in general.
status_evidence.claim: The exact rectilinear crossing number of K_n is unknown beyond small n.

status_evidence.title: Aichholzer, rectilinear crossing number project page
status_evidence.snippet: Lower and upper bounds on the asymptotic rectilinear crossing constant are continually improved.
status_evidence.claim: The problem remains open with only bounds known on the asymptotic constant.
